features.name: blue_green_ratio
features.description: Ratio of the blue-green band to the green peak band, capturing relative pigment variations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized contrast feature that helps linear SVMs separate samples based on relative color absorption rather than absolute intensity.

features.name: red_edge_slope
features.description: Difference between two bands in the red-edge region, indicating the steepness of the reflectance drop-off.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the derivative of the spectrum in a critical region, providing a strong linear margin for SVMs.

features.name: nir_intensity
features.description: Average intensity across three near-infrared bands.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooths out noise in the NIR region, providing a stable continuous measure of overall NIR reflectance.

features.name: overall_brightness
features.description: Average intensity across four widely spaced bands representing different spectral regions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a baseline normalization factor, allowing the SVM to account for overall illumination or sample thickness differences.

features.name: spectral_contrast
features.description: Difference between the maximum of the visible peaks and the minimum of the absorption valleys.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a measure of dynamic range within the spectrum, useful for defining margin boundaries in SVMs.

features.name: uv_violet_absorption
features.description: Ratio of the first UV/violet band to a slightly longer wavelength violet band.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights specific short-wavelength absorption characteristics, offering a normalized feature robust to overall brightness.

features.name: yellow_red_ratio
features.description: Ratio of a yellow band to a red band.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relative slope between the yellow and red regions, providing a smooth continuous feature for linear separation.

features.name: peak_green_prominence
features.description: Ratio of the green peak to the sum of its surrounding shoulder bands.
features.expected_model_benefit: Quantifies the sharpness of the green peak, which can be a distinguishing structural feature for the linear model.

features.name: nir_variability
features.description: Absolute difference between two near-infrared bands.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures the local variance or slope in the NIR region, providing a continuous severity measure of NIR scattering.

features.name: water_absorption_proxy
features.description: Ratio of two bands near a minor water absorption feature in the NIR.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized index that may correlate with moisture content, useful as an independent linear predictor.

features.name: semantic_spectral_shape
features.description: Semantic assessment of the overall spectral shape, scoring from 0.0 (flat/noisy) to 1.0 (smooth with distinct peaks).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures holistic structural patterns that are difficult to express with simple band math, providing a high-level linear feature.

features.name: semantic_noise_level
features.description: Semantic estimation of the high-frequency noise or scattering artifacts present in the spectrum, scored from 0.0 (clean) to 10.0 (highly noisy).
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the SVM to downweight or adjust margins for noisy samples by providing an explicit continuous noise severity measure.
